NEET UG Online Counselling 2026

Post Date: August 7, 2026

12:52 pm

National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the Online Counselling on its official website for candidates appearing in the undergraduate medical entrance examination. As per the notification, the NEET UG 2026 Re-Exam was conducted on 21 June 2026. The last date to submit the online application form was 11 March 2026. Candidates can check their re-exam Result by logging into the portal using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth.

Application Fee

  • For General : Rs. 1700/-
